name: @vssaros/dsh-relay
description: Saros relay workbench: hosts the Saros relay station web (AnyDev deployment, default http://21.6.92.5:8000/) inside a dsh page (/x/relay/), with a status bar (reachability / version / refresh / open in browser). The machine registers itself as a relay node from the IDE side after the user logs into the CodeBuddy provider. Since 0.3.0 it also runs the Node Agent (reverse WebSocket channel) inside the dsh Host: auto-started on every app launch, and started by the register button.

workbench.title: 萨罗斯中转站
workbench.description: 承载 AnyDev 上部署的萨罗斯中转站 Web；本机登录 CodeBuddy provider 后自动注册为中转站节点。
